title: p0190
universal_lens: Quarterback autonomy emerges as a time-decaying coaching intensity operator coupled to a conditional kicking-game selector, forming a dual-control system where decision authority transfers from coach to player while strategic method activation depends on relative kicker superiority metrics.
gsi_mapping: Bayesian prior over QB decision quality updates via coach retreat schedule; conformal prediction sets for kicking-game activation calibrated on kicker superiority differential; posterior self-reliance index quantifies initiative development as evidence accumulates.
gse_mapping: State-transition graph with nodes: {Coach_Dominant, Transition, QB_Autonomous}; edges triggered by week threshold and performance feedback; kicking-game selector acts as environment-dependent action mask gating special-teams policy based on kicker superiority observable.

primitives.name: Quarterback Autonomy Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: At every stage of the game the quarterback should be encouraged to make his own decisions.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: A(t) ∈ [0,1] dimensionless autonomy index; t ∈ weeks (game-weeks); τ_retreat = 2.5 weeks characteristic retreat time; C(t) ∈ [0,1] coaching intensity; I(t) ∈ [0,1] initiative/confidence level.
primitives.assumptions: Autonomy grows as coaching intensity decays exponentially post-retreat; initiative integrates autonomy history; decision quality proportional to autonomy times initiative.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singularity at t=0 if C(0)=0 (no initial coaching); breakdown if τ_retreat → ∞ (permanent overcoaching) causing A(t)→0, I(t)→0.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSE state variable QB_Autonomy in state-transition graph; GSI observable is decision accuracy rate conditioned on autonomy level; telemetry: decision_success_rate(t) vs A(t) calibration curve.
layer2.telemetry: Weekly QB decision success rate (completions, reads, audibles) correlated with autonomy index derived from coach intervention frequency.

primitives.name: Coach Retreat Kernel
primitives.verbatim_quote: After the season is two or three weeks old the quarterback coach should retire to a position of friendly criticism and encouragement.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: C(t) = C₀ exp(-(t - t₀)/τ) for t ≥ t₀; C₀ ∈ [0,1] initial intensity; t₀ = 2.5 weeks retreat trigger; τ = 1.0 week decay constant; t ∈ weeks.
primitives.assumptions: Coaching intensity decays exponentially after fixed retreat week; friendly criticism maintains non-zero floor C_min > 0; retreat timing fixed independent of performance.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breakdown if t₀ < 1 (premature retreat) causing insufficient initial conditioning; if τ → 0 (abrupt withdrawal) causing autonomy shock; if C_min = 0 (total abandonment) losing encouragement signal.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to GSE coaching intensity state variable driving QB_Autonomy transition; GSI prior on coaching effectiveness updates via retreat schedule; telemetry: coach intervention count per week vs planned decay curve.
layer2.telemetry: Observed coach-QB interaction frequency (film sessions, on-field corrections) per week mapped to C(t) trajectory.

primitives.name: Kicking Game Selector
primitives.verbatim_quote: Following is the general theory of the use of the various methods of attack: THe KIckInG GaME The kicking game should be resorted to only when one's kicker is superior to that of the opponents.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: K ∈ {0,1} kicking game activation; ΔK = μ_our - μ_opp ∈ ℝ kicker superiority differential (expected points per kick); θ ∈ ℝ activation threshold; σ_Δ ∈ ℝ uncertainty in differential.
primitives.assumptions: Kicker superiority measurable as expected points differential; activation is binary step function at threshold; uncertainty in differential follows Gaussian; ideal kick placement adds directional component.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breakdown if σ_Δ > |ΔK| (uncertainty dominates signal) causing random activation; if θ miscalibrated (over/under-estimating superiority value); if directional placement ignored reducing expected value.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSE action mask for special-teams policy; GSI conformal prediction set for ΔK covers true superiority with 95% probability; telemetry: activation decision accuracy vs post-game kicker performance differential.
layer2.telemetry: Binary activation K compared to realized ΔK from game statistics (net punting average, field goal %, kickoff return yards allowed).

The source text reveals a dual-control architecture: (1) a temporal autonomy transfer from coach to QB governed by exponential decay of coaching intensity C(t) after week t₀=2.5, yielding autonomy A(t)=1-C(t)/C₀ and integrated initiative I(t)=∫A(s)ds; (2) a conditional strategy selector for kicking game activated only when kicker superiority differential ΔK exceeds threshold θ. The QB autonomy operator is a derived kernel mapping coaching retreat schedule to decision authority state variable. The coach retreat kernel is an isomorphism to GSE coaching intensity state driving the autonomy transition. The kicking game selector is a derived kernel acting as environment-dependent action mask. Failure modes: overcoaching (τ→∞) locks A→0; premature retreat (t₀<1) yields under-conditioned QB; uncertainty-dominated ΔK (σ_Δ>|ΔK|) randomizes kicking decisions. Cross-layer coupling: QB autonomy affects kicking game execution quality (directional placement), creating feedback from QB_Autonomy to Kicking_Game_Selector efficacy.
